name: WALS features (a small subset)
source: World Atlas of Language Structures (wals.info). Typed in from Claude's memory: the feature numbers and names may be off by a letter or a word, and the value given for Mandarin is what Claude believes the atlas says. Each item carries a confidence. Check against wals.info before relying on any line.
use: Phase 7: a pattern links to the features it settles, so Hao-shuo-de can be set beside Mandarin, English and Toki Pona on word order and the like. The `hsd` field is left empty for the author to fill; Claude has not decided the language's own value.

items.name: Order of Subject, Object and Verb
items.mandarin: SVO

items.name: Order of Subject and Verb
items.mandarin: SV

items.name: Order of Object and Verb
items.mandarin: VO

items.name: Order of Adposition and Noun Phrase
items.mandarin: mostly before the noun (在 家, 从 这儿); a few after it (桌子 上, 家 里)

items.name: Order of Genitive and Noun
items.mandarin: genitive before noun (我 的 书)

items.name: Order of Adjective and Noun
items.mandarin: adjective before noun (红 的 书)

items.name: Order of Demonstrative and Noun
items.mandarin: demonstrative before noun (这 本 书)

items.name: Order of Numeral and Noun
items.mandarin: numeral before noun (三 本 书)

items.name: Order of Relative Clause and Noun
items.mandarin: relative clause before noun (我 买 的 书)

items.name: Order of Degree Word and Adjective
items.mandarin: degree word before adjective (很 大)

items.name: Position of Polar Question Particles
items.mandarin: at the end (吗)

items.name: Position of Interrogative Phrases in Content Questions
items.mandarin: in place, not moved to the front (你 吃 什么)

items.name: Definite Articles
items.mandarin: no definite or indefinite article (this, that and 一 do part of the work)

items.name: Indefinite Articles
items.mandarin: no article; the numeral 'one' can mark a new thing

items.name: Number of Genders
items.mandarin: none in speech (他 and 她 differ only in writing)

items.name: Coding of Nominal Plurality
items.mandarin: a suffix 们 for people only; most nouns have no plural mark

items.name: Numeral Classifiers
items.mandarin: obligatory with a number (三 本 书)

items.name: Politeness Distinctions in Pronouns
items.mandarin: a polite 'you' (您) next to 你

items.name: Expression of Pronominal Subjects
items.mandarin: the subject pronoun may be left out when it is clear

items.name: Negative Morphemes
items.mandarin: negative particles before the verb (不, 没)

items.name: Order of Negative Morpheme and Verb
items.mandarin: negative before the verb (不 吃)

items.name: Perfective/Imperfective Aspect
items.mandarin: marked by particles (了, 过, 着, 在)

items.name: Position of Tense-Aspect Affixes
items.mandarin: tense-aspect marks come after the verb (吃 了)

items.name: The Future Tense
items.mandarin: no inflected future; time words and 会 / 要 do the work

items.name: Relationship between the Order of Object and Verb and the Order of Adjective and Noun
items.mandarin: VO with adjective before noun
